claims.hypothesis: Does the large Lya velocity offset reflect an outflowing shell?
claims.experiment: Double Gaussian fit to [C II] and comparison with C IV and Lya velocities
claims.result: Redshifted [C II] at 702 km/s and C IV at 500 km/s, about half of the 1035 km/s Lya offset; redshifted [C II] concentrated centrally
claims.finding: Consistent with an AGN-driven expanding shell outflow

evidence.quote: The position and the velocity offsets align with a model of an outflowing shell structure, consistent with the large velocity offset of Ly$\alpha$.

claims.hypothesis: Are the CO(1-0) companions dwarf galaxies or outflows?
claims.experiment: [C II]/L_IR vs CO/L_IR PDR diagram with upper limits
claims.result: Companions lie in the [C II]-dark region, unlike CO-dark dwarfs
claims.finding: Different nature from dwarf galaxies; likely outflowing molecular clouds

evidence.quote: outflowing molecular clouds induced by the AGN is the most plausible interpretation

claims.hypothesis: Can the outflows escape the halo?
claims.experiment: Compare ~1500 km/s with escape velocity of 1e13 Msun halo
claims.result: Two of three exceed escape velocity at projected distances

evidence.quote: for two out of the three CO(1–0) companions, we found that their outflow velocities are larger than their local escape velocity of a $10^{13}\,M_{\odot}$ halo.

why_this_method.value: [C II] chosen as best kinematic tracer of ISM

evidence.quote: [C ii] 158 $\mu$m fine structure line has been known as the best kinematic tracer of the global ISM properties in high-redshift galaxies

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Companions at a different redshift as dwarf galaxies; dusty H I absorber for the Lya offset

evidence.quote: an alternative interpretation is that the velocity offset is caused by a dusty H i absorber.

limitations_admitted.value: Only projected distances and radial velocities known; spatial offset of redshifted [C II] smaller than beam

evidence.quote: Although we only have the information of the projected distances and the radial velocities instead of the actual distances and velocities

referee_caveats_inferred: Redshifted [C II] component is low significance (amplitude 0.15±0.05 mJy) and spatially offset by less than the beam
Outflow interpretation for CO companions relies on assumed association and projected distances
Dusty HI absorber alternative not excluded
